 **Villages**
 **Total number of registered voters**

The number of people who did not vote in village P is what percentage more than that who did not vote in village R?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 
• Number of voters in village P = 1100
 
• Percentage of people who voted in village P = 68%
 
• Number of voters in village R = 1200
 
• Percentage of people who voted in village R = 73%

**Formula Used:**

Number of people who did not vote = Total number of registered voters - (Percentage of people who voted × Total number of registered voters)/100

Percentage difference = [(Value1 - Value2) / Value2] × 100

**Calculation:**

Number of people who did not vote in village P = 1100 - (68 × 1100)/100

⇒ 1100 - 748 = 352

Number of people who did not vote in village R = 1200 - (73 × 1200)/100

⇒ 1200 - 876 = 324

Percentage difference = [(352 - 324) / 324] × 100

⇒ (28 / 324) × 100

⇒ 8.64%

⇒ 8(52)/(81)% (Converting the decimal into fraction for the given options)

**The number of people who did not vote in village P is 8(52)/(81)% more than that who did not vote in village R.**

What is the respective ratio between the total number of employees in organisations L and M together in 2015, and the total number of employees in organisations M and N together in 2017?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Table showing the number of employees in three organisations (L, M, N) during three years (2015, 2016, 2017).

**Calculation:**

Total number of employees in organisations L and M together in 2015:

= Employees in L (2015) + Employees in M (2015)

= 1421 + 1459

⇒ 2880

Total number of employ
ees in organisations M and N together in 2017:

= Employees in M (2017) + Employees in N (2017)

= 1740 + 1235

⇒ 2975

Respective ratio = (Total employees in L and M in 2015) : (Total employees in M and N in 2017)

= 2880 : 2975

To simplify the ratio, divide both numbers by their greatest common divisor. Both numbers are divisible by 5.

2880 ÷ 5 = 576

2975 ÷ 5 = 595

⇒ Ratio = 576 : 595

**∴ The respective ratio is 576 : 595.**

The given table shows the number of different types of batteries (numbers in lakhs) sold by a company over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9d4920877295789e37035406a1e7be2680179c6d24689a455234437aa45178c.png] 

The total number of all types of batteries sold in 2013 is what percentage more or less (rounded off to the nearest integer) than the total number of all types of batteries sold in 2011?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Table showing number of different types of batteries sold over the years (in lakhs).

**Formula used:**

Percentage change = [(New value - Old value) / Old value] × 100

**Calculation:**

Total batteries sold in 2011 = 82 + 100 + 130 + 120 = 432 lakhs

Total batteries sold in 2013 = 85 + 165 + 112 + 162 = 524 lakhs

Difference = 524 - 432 = 92 lakhs

Percentage increase = (92 / 432) × 100

Percentage increase ≈ 21.29%

Rounded off to the nearest integer = 21%

**∴ The total number of all types of batteries sold in 2013 is 21% more than the total number of all types of batteries sold in 2011.**

**∴ The correct answer is option 1. More, 21%**
